24600.name: The Crevice Between The Paths

north.description: To the north lies In The Entrance To The Manigua Thicket.

west.description: To the west lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

24600.description:
The crevice splits the mountainside into two cold walls of dark rock, so
narrow that your shoulders brush stone on either hand. Bone-white lichen
crusts the cracks, and a thin wind whistles through carrying a smell of
smoke and old blood. The way west opens back onto the path by the tall
tower wall, while to the north a door woven of black thorn and hung with
knotted cords stands ajar on the thicket.

24601.name: In The Entrance To The Manigua Thicket

north.description: To the north lies In The Manigua Thicket.

east.description: To the east lies In The Manigua Thicket.

south.description: To the south lies The Crevice Between The Paths.

west.description: To the west lies In The Manigua Thicket.

24601.description:
You stand where the crevice gives way to the entrance of the Manigua
Thicket, a green mouth of knotted briar and twisted trunks. Pale cords
strung with bird skulls sway from the lowest boughs and click softly in
the breeze. Narrow tunnels of leaves lead north, east and west into the
thicket, and the thorn door south leads back to the crevice.

24602.name: In The Manigua Thicket

south.description: To the south lies In The Entrance To The Manigua Thicket.

east.description: To the east lies In The Manigua Thicket.

north.description: To the north lies In The Manigua Thicket.

west.description: To the west lies In The Manigua Thicket.

24602.description:
Thorned branches knit overhead so tightly that the daylight comes down
green and broken. The ground is a mat of rotted leaves, scored with the
deep gouges of tusks. Every way you turn looks the same, a wall of briar
and bent trunks, and somewhere close a branch snaps and goes still.

24603.name: In The Manigua Thicket

west.description: To the west lies In The Manigua Thicket.

north.description: To the north lies In The Manigua Thicket.

24603.description:
A fallen oak lies rotting across the thicket here, its bark stripped and
stained brown with something that is not sap. Brambles have grown up
through the split trunk and hook at your cloak whenever you shift your
weight. The air is thick and sweetish, and the faint beat of a far drum
seems to travel through the roots.

24604.name: In The Manigua Thicket

south.description: To the south lies In The Manigua Thicket.

24604.description:
The briars part into a low hollow where the earth is trampled flat and
ringed with small cairns of river stones. Strips of faded red cloth hang
from the thorns, each one knotted by a careful hand. Moss on the nearest
stones is black and crusted, and a cold breath stirs the leaves though
no wind reaches this deep.

24605.name: In The Manigua Thicket

south.description: To the south lies In The Manigua Thicket.

north.description: To the north lies In The Manigua Thicket.

24605.description:
Slender spears of light find their way through the canopy and pick out a
web as wide as a cart wheel strung between two trunks. It is hung with
the dry husks of small beasts, turning slowly. Thorns the length of a
finger rake the air on every side, and the ground squelches softly
underfoot.

24606.name: In The Manigua Thicket

south.description: To the south lies In The Manigua Thicket.

24606.description:
A rutted game trail winds through the thickest part of the Manigua, so
low that you must stoop beneath the arching canes. Fresh mud is churned
along it, and the bark of the nearby trunks is rubbed raw to the height
of your hip. A humming you feel more than hear rises from the earth, as
if great stones lay buried close by.

24607.name: The Stone Entrance

north.description: To the north lies The Stone Portal.

east.description: To the east lies The Stone Portal.

south.description: To the south lies The Stone Portal.

west.description: To the west lies The Stone Portal.

up.description: To the up lies The Stone Portal.

down.description: To the down lies The Stone Portal.

24607.description:
A broad flat of trampled grass opens before a ring of grey monoliths,
each taller than three men and cut with spiral grooves. No matter which
way you turn, north, east, south, west, up or down, the only road is
through the Stone Portal. The stones hum low and steady, and the grass
at their feet is stained a rusty brown.

24608.name: In The Manigua Thicket

east.description: To the east lies In The Manigua Thicket.

24608.description:
The thicket is at its densest here, the trunks so close that the way is
a crawl under dripping boughs. Cobwebs bind the branches together, and
the leaf litter is deep, soft and pale with fungus. A trail of crushed
bracken leads onward toward a lighter patch of ground.

24609.name: The Clearing In The Thicket

east.description: To the east lies In The Manigua Thicket.

down.description: To the down lies The Lair Of The Thicket Beast.

24609.description:
The thicket opens into a small clearing of bare, churned earth, ringed
with piles of gnawed bones and rough brush walls. In its centre a hole
yawns, its edges worn smooth by a heavy body, and a hot, rank breath
rises from it. The way east leads back into the thicket, and a steep
passage descends into the dark.

24610.name: The Lair Of The Thicket Beast

up.description: To the up lies The Clearing In The Thicket.

down.description: To the down lies The Stone Portal.

24610.description:
The beast's lair is a low, ragged cavity in the rock, its floor strewn
with broken bones and wads of matted fur. The stone walls are rubbed
smooth and glossy by a huge body passing to and fro, and a sour musk
fills the air. A rough passage climbs up to the clearing in the thicket,
and another leads down toward the Stone Portal.

24612.name: The Stone Portal

north.description: To the north lies The Stone Portal.

west.description: To the west lies The Avenue.

up.description: To the up lies The Lair Of The Thicket Beast.

south.description: To the south lies The Stone Entrance.

east.description: To the east lies The Stone Entrance.

down.description: To the down lies The Stone Entrance.

24612.description:
The Stone Portal is a gateway of two vast uprights capped by a lintel,
black with old smoke and slick with a greasy sheen. Rust-red handprints
climb the pillars as high as a man could reach. A paved avenue leads
west into the stone city, while a trodden strip of grass to the north
curls round and returns to the portal. Drums pulse faintly through the
soles of your boots.

24613.name: The Avenue

west.description: To the west lies At The Slaughter Stone.

east.description: To the east lies The Stone Portal.

24613.description:
A wide avenue of grey flagstones runs west between rows of squat stone
houses, their doorways hung with hides and strings of bone. The paving
is dished by countless feet and stained dark in long channels along the
gutters. Ahead, the avenue ends at a low, broad rock, and a heavy smell
of copper drifts back along it.

24614.name: At The Slaughter Stone

north.description: To the north lies The Beginning Of The Stone Circle.

east.description: To the east lies The Avenue.

24614.description:
The Slaughter Stone squats here, a waist-high slab of black rock with a
shallow bowl worn in its top and grooves running to its edges. Long
years of sacrifice have turned the ground around it to a hard crust the
colour of rust. Iron rings are set into its flanks. The avenue lies back
to the east, and the great ring of the circle begins to the north.

extra_descs.slaughter stone bowl rings:
The black slab is hollowed like a basin, and the grooves in it run to a
notch on the lowest edge. The iron rings are polished bright on the
inside where ropes and chains have rubbed them.

24615.name: The Beginning Of The Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies At The Slaughter Stone.

24615.description:
Here the great ring begins: a curve of standing stones, each carved with
a face whose mouth hangs open as if caught mid-scream. Dried herbs and
ragged feathers are tied about their bases. The path runs north along
the inside of the circle, and the Slaughter Stone lies a few paces
south, still reeking of old sacrifice.

24616.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies The Beginning Of The Stone Circle.

24616.description:
The stones here lean slightly inward, as if listening, their flanks
scabbed with yellow lichen. A drainage groove cut into the path carries
a thin dark trickle toward the Slaughter Stone. Chimes of knuckle and
rib hang from a crossbar between two uprights and knock together in the
draught. The path goes on north around the circle and back south toward
its beginning.

24617.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

24617.description:
A drum frame of lashed antlers stands against the inner edge of the
path, its skin head stretched taut and dyed with red palm prints. It is
silent now, but the stone beside it still seems to tremble. Weeds grow
in the cracks of the paving, and the track runs on north and south
around the ring.

24618.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

24618.description:
Two standing stones lean together here to make a crooked arch, and the
ground beneath is bare and packed hard as a threshing floor. Scratched
into the lower stone are tally marks in rows, hundreds upon hundreds.
The circle bends sharply ahead to the north, and the way south runs back
along the ring.

extra_descs.tally marks scratches:
Row on row of short strokes, scratched with a flint and grouped in
fives. Whoever kept the count never finished it.

24619.name: A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies The First Altar Of The Stones.

24619.description:
The circle turns sharply here, the path hugging a stone so broad that it
throws a deep shadow well into the day. A smaller track breaks off west
toward the First Altar Of The Stones, and the way south follows the ring
back. Long scars mark the great stone, as though something once clawed
or chained itself against it.

24620.name: The First Altar Of The Stones

north.description: To the north lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

east.description: To the east lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

24620.description:
The First Altar is a low table of rough rock, the top hollowed and
crusted with dried black offerings. Bundles of thorn and bleached bone
lie heaped at its foot, and the air is heavy with the sour reek of burnt
fat. The stones around it hum, a low note that settles in your teeth.
The only way out is north, back to the bend in the circle.

24621.name: A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle

south.description: To the south lies The First Altar Of The Stones.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Stone Circle.

24621.description:
The path swings around a corner stone carved with a coiling serpent
whose scales are worn smooth by passing hands. A short track dips south
to the First Altar Of The Stones. The circle continues west, and a cold
draught comes along it smelling of wet earth and woodsmoke.

24622.name: Around the Stone Circle

east.description: To the east lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Stone Circle.

24622.description:
Flat paving slabs lie here in a neat row, each cut with a spiral from
edge to centre and rubbed dark in the middle. Flecks of straw and dried
blood cling to the seams between them. Tall stones stand on either side
of the path, which runs east and west along the ring.

24623.name: Around the Stone Circle

east.description: To the east lies Around the Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Stone Circle.

24623.description:
The ground rises a little on a low bank of turf, and the stones above it
wear collars of rope hung with small clay faces. A soot-black stain
streaks down the nearest upright from a hollow near its crown. Wind
sighs through the gaps between the stones as the way runs east and west.

24624.name: Around the Stone Circle

east.description: To the east lies Around the Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies By The Pit Stones.

24624.description:
Ahead, the ground dips toward a squat building of heaped slabs, and the
air grows closer and ranker. Piles of antlers and split bones lie by the
roadside, bleached by the weather. The path east follows the ring, while
the way west leads into the Pit Stones.

24625.name: By The Pit Stones

east.description: To the east lies Around the Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies In The Middle Of The Pit Stones.

24625.description:
Massive slabs have been leaned together to roof a long, low hall, and
the air inside is cold, close and smelling of old straw. Torches of
pitch-soaked reed smoulder in iron brackets, laying a red light on the
rough walls. Deep scratches score the floor, which slopes gently toward
the west. The way east leads out to the circle.

24626.name: In The Middle Of The Pit Stones

north.description: To the north lies The Quarters Of The High Priest.

east.description: To the east lies By The Pit Stones.

west.description: To the west lies By The Pit Stones.

24626.description:
In the middle of the Pit Stones the floor falls away into a shallow
trough ringed with stout posts, the hard earth packed with old blood and
sawdust. Smoky torches burn along the walls, and the shadows of the
posts crawl across the roof slabs. Passages lead east and west through
the hall, and a heavy door of dark wood stands in the north wall.

24627.name: The Quarters Of The High Priest

north.description: To the north lies The Quarters Of The High Priest.

east.description: To the east lies The Vault Of The Stone Priest.

south.description: To the south lies In The Middle Of The Pit Stones.

west.description: To the west lies Dark Office Of The Stone Priest.

24627.description:
The High Priest's quarters are a wide room of dressed stone hung with
tanned hides and trophies of horn and tooth. A great bed of furs fills
one corner, and a fire pit glows red in the middle of the floor. Doors
of iron-bound oak open east to a vault and west to a dark office, and
the way south returns to the pit hall. A curtained archway on the north
side only loops back into the same room.

24628.name: The Vault Of The Stone Priest

west.description: To the west lies The Quarters Of The High Priest.

24628.description:
The vault is a squat chamber of fitted stone, its ceiling so low that
you stoop to enter. Iron-banded chests, long since smashed open and
emptied, line the walls, and the dust holds the ghost-shapes of a
vanished hoard. A single dry brazier hangs from a chain. The only way
out is west, back to the priest's quarters.

24629.name: Dark Office Of The Stone Priest

east.description: To the east lies The Quarters Of The High Priest.

24629.description:
Narrow slits let in almost no light, and the office stays dim even at
noon. Shelves of clay tablets and knotted record-cords climb the walls,
and a table of black stone is scored with columns of accounts in a
cramped hand. A cold smell of tallow and old ink clings to everything.
The only door leads east to the High Priest's quarters.

24630.name: By The Pit Stones

east.description: To the east lies In The Middle Of The Pit Stones.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Stone Circle.

24630.description:
At this end of the Pit Stones the roof slabs rise higher, and a grey
light creeps in from the way west, where the hall opens onto the ring.
Piles of knucklebones and broken clay cups lie in the corners, and a
rank smell of sweat and straw hangs about. The trough floor lies back to
the east.

24631.name: Around the Stone Circle

east.description: To the east lies By The Pit Stones.

west.description: To the west lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

24631.description:
A fire-blackened stone stands beside the path with a ring of ash at its
foot, still faintly warm. Strings of wolf teeth are tied to a post by
the track and rattle with every gust. The low hall of the Pit Stones
lies east, and the way west leads to a turn in the circle.

24632.name: A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle

east.description: To the east lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies The Second Altar Of The Stones.

24632.description:
The ring turns here at a stone split down the middle by lightning, its
two halves blackened and leaning apart. Beneath it a path leads south to
the Second Altar Of The Stones, and the circle runs back east. Charred
splinters lie scattered across the beaten earth, and the smell of
scorched rock lingers.

extra_descs.split stone lightning:
The stone is cleft from crown to root, and the heart of it is glassy
where the fire passed through. Priests say the sky itself once struck
here in anger.

24633.name: The Second Altar Of The Stones

west.description: To the west lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

north.description: To the north lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

24633.description:
The Second Altar is a drum-shaped block of stone, its sides carved with
lines of kneeling figures bearing bowls. The top is stained in dark
rings, one atop another, like the growth of a tree. Rags and braided
hair are knotted about its posts, and the air hums sharply. The only
path leads west back to the bend.

24634.name: A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle

east.description: To the east lies The Second Altar Of The Stones.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

24634.description:
The path bends around a squat boulder shaped like a hunched old man, its
face worn almost away. East, a short track leads to the Second Altar Of
The Stones, and the ring carries on south. Dry thistles rattle in the
cracks of the paving, and the hum of the stones is thin and high.

24635.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

24635.description:
A horned skull the size of a cart wheel is mounted on a pole beside the
path, its eye sockets packed with red clay. Beyond it the stones stand
in a crooked row, their tops furred with moss. The path runs north to a
bend and south along the ring.

24636.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

24636.description:
Rain has pooled in the ruts of the path, and the water has a rusty tint
where it laps the paving. A tall stone beside it is pitted with hollows
where the hands of worshippers have pressed. The ring runs north and
south, and the air hums faintly around the monoliths.

24637.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

24637.description:
A standing stone lies toppled across the verge, half buried in nettles,
and the others seem to crowd closer to fill the gap. Its underside,
turned up to the light, is covered with carved spirals gone green with
moss. The circle path continues north and south, packed hard by
generations of feet.

24638.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

24638.description:
Rows of tiny cairns, no bigger than a fist, line both edges of the path,
each topped with a single tooth or chip of bone. Between them the grass
has been trodden away by slow processions. The stones loom close on one
hand, and the path leads north and south around the ring.

24639.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

24639.description:
A flat stone the size of a cart bed has been laid over a round hole in
the path, and a sour, cold air breathes from the gaps around it. Iron
staples hold it down, rusted red. The way runs north and south, and the
nearby stones hum at a deeper pitch than elsewhere.

extra_descs.flat stone hole staples:
The slab is held down with six iron staples, and a pale scratch along
one edge shows where someone has tried to prise it up.

24640.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

24640.description:
Tattered banners of tanned hide hang from the uprights here, painted
with crude suns, serpents and open hands. They snap in the wind,
rattling the bone beads sewn along their hems. The path leads north
around the ring and south to a sharp bend.

24641.name: A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

east.description: To the east lies The Third Altar Of The Stones.

24641.description:
The circle makes a sharp turn at a stone wrapped in a collar of red-dyed
wool. A narrow track leads east to the Third Altar Of The Stones, and
the ring runs back north. The ground is pocked with the holes of old
stakes, and an iron smell lingers in the air.

24642.name: The Third Altar Of The Stones

south.description: To the south lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

24642.description:
The Third Altar rises on three steps of rough stone, its top flat and
scorched black by fires lit upon it. Ladders of chain hang from a wooden
frame at its side, rusted and crusted with something dark. The humming
here is almost a voice. The only way out is south, to the bend in the
circle.

24643.name: A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies The Third Altar Of The Stones.

east.description: To the east lies Around the Stone Circle.

24643.description:
The path turns past a corner stone wrapped in a rope of dried vines,
hung with little bundles of hair. A short track climbs north to the
Third Altar Of The Stones, and the circle runs on east. The ground is
hard and pale, scuffed by generations of dancing feet.

24644.name: Around the Stone Circle

east.description: To the east lies Around the Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

24644.description:
Eyes have been carved into the face of the nearest standing stone,
dozens of them in staring rows, each rimmed with red ochre. It is easy
to feel watched here. The circle path runs east and west, bordered by
clumps of thistle.

extra_descs.eyes carved stone ochre:
No two of the carved eyes are alike. Some weep grooves of red, and some
are crossed out with a single hard stroke.

24645.name: Around the Stone Circle

east.description: To the east lies Around the Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Stone Circle.

24645.description:
A row of sharpened stakes, grey with age, stands along the edge of the
path, each topped with a rag of cloth. The stones behind them are black
with smoke, and the ground between is scattered with trodden embers. The
way leads east and west around the ring.

24646.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Chamber Of Elements.

east.description: To the east lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies The Room Of The Sun.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Stone Circle.

24646.description:
Here the path meets two doors set into squat stone buildings that crowd
the inner side of the ring, one to the north and one to the south, each
framed by a massive carved lintel. The north door is stamped with signs
of flame, wave, wind and rock. The ring runs on east and west, and the
pavement underfoot is cleaner swept than elsewhere.

24647.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Chamber Of The White Alchemist.

east.description: To the east lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies Chamber Of The Dark Alchemist.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Stone Circle.

24647.description:
The path passes two doors here, the one to the north painted white and
the one to the south painted black, both bearing alchemical signs in
silver and soot. Between them the pavement is stained with spilled
reagents in every colour. The ring leads east and west, and a sharp,
bitter fume hangs on the air.

24648.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Cell Block.

east.description: To the east lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies Cell Block.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Stone Circle.

24648.description:
Two iron-studded doors face each other across the path here, one on the
north side and one on the south, each with a narrow grille at head
height. Scratches mark the stone about the frames, and a stale smell of
old straw and sweat seeps through. The ring runs on east to a bend and
west along the path.

24649.name: A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies The Altar Of The Sun.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Stone Circle.

24649.description:
The ring turns again here beside a lopsided stone that tilts over the
path like a bowed head. Burnt-down sticks of incense are stuck in every
crack, and soot streaks the rock above. The Altar Of The Sun lies north,
and the circle runs on west.

24650.name: The Altar Of The Sun

east.description: To the east lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

24650.description:
The Altar Of The Sun is a wide disc of yellow stone set flat in the
earth, its surface carved with rays and rimmed with gutters stained
dark. A stout post stands at its centre, black with old burns. The
paving is warm underfoot. Paths lead east to the bend of the circle and
south to another turn.

extra_descs.sun disc altar post:
The carved rays run out from the central post like the spokes of a
wheel. Each gutter ends in a notch at the disc's edge, as if to let
something drain away.

24651.name: A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies The Altar Of The Sun.

24651.description:
The circle bends sharply around a stone cut with a great sunburst, its
rays picked out in ochre that still glows in the light. A flight of
steps leads west to the Altar Of The Sun, and the ring runs north. The
paving is warm and dry, and a smell of burnt herbs lingers.

24652.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

24652.description:
A tall pole stands in the verge of the path, hung with the dry, curling
skins of long-dead beasts and topped with a rack of antlers. The wind
sets the skins clapping like a distant crowd. The way runs north along
the ring and south to a sharp bend.

24653.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

24653.description:
A weathered monolith here is crowned with a ring of ragged rope and
shells, and the path at its foot is strewn with broken pottery. Sherds
crunch underfoot as the track continues north and south along the
circle. The humming of the stones rises and falls like breathing.

24654.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

24654.description:
Hung from a gibbet of lashed timber beside the path is an empty iron
cage, its door open and its bars worn bright where hands have gripped
them. The stones beyond it are blackened at their feet by long-dead
fires. The path runs north and south around the ring.

24655.name: Around the Stone Circle

north.description: To the north lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

24655.description:
Thick white roots, thin as ropes, have forced up the paving here and
broken it into tilted plates. The stones on both sides lean outward,
giving the path a cramped, tunnelled feel. The ring runs north to a bend
and south along the circle.

24656.name: A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies The Altar Of Hydroglix.

24656.description:
The circle swings round a corner stone stained green along its lower
half, as if it stood often in water. The path drops a little here, and
the earth is soft and cold. A track leads west to the Altar Of
Hydroglix, and the way south follows the ring.

24657.name: The Altar Of Hydroglix

north.description: To the north lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

east.description: To the east lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

24657.description:
The Altar Of Hydroglix is a ring of blue-green stone around a shallow
basin, its rim carved with rippling waves and the long, whiskered faces
of river spirits. The basin holds a stagnant, still pool, covered with a
skin of green. A path leads north to a bend in the circle and another
east along the ring.

24658.name: A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle

south.description: To the south lies The Altar Of Hydroglix.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Stone Circle.

24658.description:
The ring bends sharply at a tall corner stone crowned with a skull of
some great horned beast, its sockets filled with moss. South, a short
track leads to the Altar Of Hydroglix, and the circle continues west.
The grass here is flattened in long strips, as though heavy sledges have
been dragged across it.

24659.name: Around the Stone Circle

east.description: To the east lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Stone Circle.

24659.description:
A broad stone stands at the path's edge, plastered with the dry mud of
many hands and sprouting small ferns from its crevices. A pair of bone
flutes, long and thin, hang from a thong at its side, swaying and
whistling. The path runs west along the ring, and east it bends sharply.

24660.name: Around the Stone Circle

east.description: To the east lies Around the Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Stone Circle.

24660.description:
The turf beside the path has been trodden into a perfect circle, bare
and hard, where some great dance must be held at night. Stakes at its
edge bear faded streamers, and the ground rings faintly underfoot. The
ring path goes on east and west.

24661.name: Around the Stone Circle

east.description: To the east lies Around the Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Stone Circle.

24661.description:
Faces are carved along the lower flanks of the stones here, each a flat
grinning mask with sunken eyes, and a few have been daubed with fresh
red paint. Dust lies thick in the creases, and a cold, scratching
draught moves between the monoliths. The path runs east and west along
the ring.

24662.name: Around the Stone Circle

east.description: To the east lies Around the Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies A Sharp Bend in the Stone Circle.

24662.description:
A long cord strung between two uprights holds a row of dried gourds,
hollow and rattling with seeds, that clack together in the wind. The
path below is polished by bare feet and ringed with the pale scuffs of
dancers. The ring of stones runs east and west.

24663.name: A Sharp Bend in the Stone Circle

east.description: To the east lies Around the Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies The Altar of Zacchariath.

24663.description:
The circle bends here around a stone with a deep bowl hollowed in its
crown, a small pool of rainwater trembling in it. Handfuls of grain and
withered flowers lie scattered at its foot. The track runs east along
the ring, and a short way south lies the Altar of Zacchariath.

24664.name: The Altar of Zacchariath

north.description: To the north lies A Sharp Bend in the Stone Circle.

west.description: To the west lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

24664.description:
The Altar of Zacchariath is a squat stone table veined with red, flanked
by two pillars crowned with ram's horns. Black candle stubs crust its
edges, and a ladder of notches is cut down one side, one for each
offering made. The hum of the stone is slow and heavy here. A path leads
north to a bend in the circle, and another west to the lane at the
corner stone.

24665.name: A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle

east.description: To the east lies The Altar of Zacchariath.

south.description: To the south lies Inside The Stone City.

24665.description:
A sharp bend turns the stone circle, the path pressed between a huge
corner stone and a ditch grown with tall grass. The corner stone is
carved with the figure of a kneeling woman, her arms raised as if in
pleading. A track leads east to the Altar of Zacchariath, and the lane
south returns to the stone city.

24666.name: Inside The Stone City

north.description: To the north lies A Sharp Bend In The Stone Circle.

south.description: To the south lies Inside The Stone City.

24666.description:
The lane narrows between two high slabs, so that only a thin strip of
sky shows overhead. Strands of dried gut are hung between the stones,
rattling like old chimes. The lane leads north to a turn in the circle,
and south into the stone city.

24667.name: Inside The Stone City

north.description: To the north lies Inside The Stone City.

south.description: To the south lies The Altar Of Power.

24667.description:
Tall slabs of weathered stone line a broad lane here, each one carved
with a hunched, wide-mouthed face. The ground is hard, dark and pocked
with the marks of heavy feet. The lane runs north deeper into the stone
city, and south toward the Altar Of Power.

24668.name: The Altar Of Power

north.description: To the north lies Inside The Stone City.

east.description: To the east lies The Altar Of Arms.

24668.description:
The Altar Of Power is a high seat hewn from a single block, with arms
carved as the coiled bodies of serpents. A ring of broad steps surrounds
it, worn hollow at the centre. Cold light falls from a gap in the sky
above, and the air hums like a plucked string. A way leads north into
the stone city, and another east to the Altar Of Arms.

24669.name: The Altar Of Arms

south.description: To the south lies The Great Altar Of The Eclipse.

west.description: To the west lies The Altar Of Power.

24669.description:
Rusted blades, cracked shields and broken spears are set in rows upon
this long altar, offerings from battles fought and lost long ago. The
stone beneath them is stained a deep brown. The Great Altar Of The
Eclipse lies to the south, and a narrower way leads west to the Altar Of
Power.

24670.name: The Great Altar Of The Eclipse

north.description: To the north lies The Altar Of Arms.

east.description: To the east lies Inside The Great Stone.

24670.description:
A vast round altar of black stone fills this chamber, its top inlaid
with a disc of polished black glass that gives back no reflection. Pale
scratches crowd the floor around it in long arcs. A door leads east to
the Great Stone, and the way north leads on to the Altar Of Arms.

extra_descs.black glass disc altar:
The disc is flawless and cold to the touch. Its surface shows only the
dark, and the faint outline of your own hand against it.

24671.name: Inside The Great Stone

east.description: To the east lies Through The Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Altar Of The Eclipse.

24671.description:
You stand in a great hollow within the Great Stone, a passage lit only
by what spills in from the path, its walls carved with long processions
of figures bearing burdens. The air is cool and still, and the hum of
the stone is almost unbearable here. The path lies back east, and the
Great Altar Of The Eclipse waits west.

24672.name: Through The Path

east.description: To the east lies Through The Path.

west.description: To the west lies Inside The Great Stone.

24672.description:
The path squeezes between two blocks of stone so close that they brush
your sleeves, then widens again. Red ochre has been smeared on both
walls at head height in broad sweeps. The path leads east, while west it
ends at the great mass of the Great Stone.

24673.name: Through The Path

north.description: To the north lies Inside The City Of Sacrifice.

west.description: To the west lies Through The Path.

24673.description:
A paved path runs here with ditches on either side, each choked with
trampled reeds and fallen branches. Poles topped with skulls mark its
edges and lean at drunken angles. The city lies north, and the path goes
on west.

24674.name: Inside The City Of Sacrifice

north.description: To the north lies The Plaza.

east.description: To the east lies The Burrow In The Altar.

south.description: To the south lies Through The Path.

24674.description:
Narrow lanes of fitted stone wind between low walls blackened by smoke,
the gutters running dark. Hides are pegged out to dry on frames beside
the doorways. The Plaza lies north, a low opening leads east into the
Burrow In The Altar, and the lane goes on south as a path.

24675.name: The Burrow In The Altar

west.description: To the west lies Inside The City Of Sacrifice.

24675.description:
A cramped hollow lies in the side of a huge altar block, lined with
matted straw and furs where someone has long made a bed. The walls are
smooth and cold, and the smell is musty, of damp fur and old meat. The
only way out is west.

24676.name: The Plaza

north.description: To the north lies The Arched Entrance.

east.description: To the east lies The Plaza.

south.description: To the south lies Inside The City Of Sacrifice.

24676.description:
This part of the plaza is dominated by a squat platform of scorched
stone, blackened at the edges where fires have been lit. Smoke-stained
pillars stand about the open ground. An arched entrance rises to the
north, the plaza continues east, and a lane leads south into the City Of
Sacrifice.

24678.name: The Plaza

north.description: To the north lies The Golden Fountain.

east.description: To the east lies Corner Of The Plaza.

west.description: To the west lies The Plaza.

24678.description:
The paving of the plaza is cut with great concentric rings, and in the
shallow grooves between them dark stains have gathered. Stunted weeds
grow where the stones have heaved. The Golden Fountain splashes to the
north, more rings stretch west across the Plaza, and a corner lies east.

24679.name: Corner Of The Plaza

north.description: To the north lies Corner Of The Plaza.

west.description: To the west lies The Plaza.

24679.description:
At this corner of the plaza a rank of low stone benches faces inward,
their seats black with old grease. A pole painted in red and white bands
rises from the paving, its tip hung with a tangle of feathers. The way
north follows the edge of the plaza, and the way west leads on into the
open Plaza.

24680.name: Corner Of The Plaza

south.description: To the south lies Corner Of The Plaza.

west.description: To the west lies The Golden Fountain.

24680.description:
The plaza turns here in a neat corner marked by a squat pillar, its top
carved with a grinning sun. Weeds push up between the flagstones, and
the wind carries a smell of woodsmoke and roasting meat. Open ground
lies back west toward the Golden Fountain, and the paving runs south to
another corner.

24681.name: The Golden Fountain

north.description: To the north lies The Guards Hall.

east.description: To the east lies Corner Of The Plaza.

south.description: To the south lies The Plaza.

west.description: To the west lies The Arched Entrance.

24681.description:
The Golden Fountain rises from a ring of cracked paving, a basin of
gilded stone whose spout is carved as a roaring mouth. The water that
pours from it is murky and tinged red. A door in the north leads into
the Guards Hall, an arched entrance lies west, a corner of the plaza
spreads east, and the Plaza itself opens south.

24682.name: The Arched Entrance

east.description: To the east lies The Golden Fountain.

south.description: To the south lies The Plaza.

west.description: To the west lies The Circle Of The Altars.

24682.description:
A tall arch of dark stone spans the way here, carved with writhing vines
and open mouths. A door of heavy planks stands to the west, and beyond
it you can glimpse a ring of altars. The murmur of the Golden Fountain
comes from the east, and the plaza lies south.

24683.name: The Chief Guard's Office

east.description: To the east lies The Guards Hall.

south.description: To the south lies Cell Block.

24683.description:
A broad desk of scarred oak fills most of this cramped office, its top
cut with knife marks and ringed by the stains of many mugs. Keys hang on
a board by the door, and a rack of spiked clubs leans against the wall.
The air is warm and smells of leather and tallow. A passage leads east
to the Guards Hall, and a door south opens on the cell block.

24684.name: The Guards Hall

south.description: To the south lies The Golden Fountain.

west.description: To the west lies The Chief Guard's Office.

24684.description:
Long trestle tables run the length of this stone hall, scarred by dice
and daggers, with benches worn smooth by years of sitting. A hearth at
one end holds a heap of cold ash, and spears are racked along the wall
under cheap tallow lamps. A door leads west to the Chief Guard's Office,
and the way south opens onto the Golden Fountain.

24685.name: The Circle Of The Altars

north.description: To the north lies The Silver Altar.

east.description: To the east lies The Arched Entrance.

south.description: To the south lies The Golden Altar.

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Inside The Altar.

24685.description:
Stone altars stand in a ring about a shallow sunken court, each carved
with a different beast's head. The floor is polished by years of bare
feet, and the air is thick with incense. The Silver Altar lies north,
the Golden Altar south, a dark tunnel opens west, and the arched
entrance lies back east.

24686.name: The Silver Altar

south.description: To the south lies The Circle Of The Altars.

24686.description:
The Silver Altar is a block of pale stone sheathed in tarnished plates
of silver, beaten with wolf and moon patterns. Dried sprigs of mistletoe
lie scattered across its top, and the ground is stained with old
libations. The only way out is south, to the circle of altars.

24687.name: The Golden Altar

north.description: To the north lies The Circle Of The Altars.

24687.description:
The Golden Altar glints dully, its top plated with a thin leaf of gold
that peels from the stone in curls. Horns and ribs are bound with red
cords at its corners, and a heavy sweetness hangs in the air. The way
out lies north, to the circle of altars.

24688.name: The Grand Stone Of Jostoricath

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Inside The Altar.

24688.description:
The Grand Stone of Jostoricath stands in a ring of bare earth, a
monolith twice the height of any other, its surface covered in writhing
glyphs that seem to gleam when you look away. The ground around it is
polished pale as bone. The hum that runs through the whole circle seems
to rise from here, and the air tastes of metal.

extra_descs.glyphs grand stone jostoricath:
The glyphs crawl in tight, interlocking lines, and your eye keeps losing
its place among them. One symbol, a wide-open eye, recurs near the top.

24689.name: Chamber Of Elements

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

24689.description:
Four bowls of different stone stand in the corners of this round
chamber, one holding a low flame, one dark water, one pale grit and one
a coil of drifting smoke. The ceiling is domed and the walls are painted
with swirling bands of colour. The air is oddly still and smells of rain
and hot metal. The only door leads south.

24691.name: The Room Of The Sun

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

24691.description:
A round chamber with a domed ceiling painted gold, and a great sun disc
set in the floor, ringed with spokes of inlaid brass. The walls are hung
with faded yellow banners, and the air is warm and dry as a summer noon.
A dull light seems to come from the ceiling itself. The only door leads
north.

24692.name: Chamber Of The White Alchemist

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

24692.description:
The chamber is scrubbed and pale, with shelves of glass flasks, clay
jars and wax-sealed pots lining the walls. A long bench of white stone
holds a still, its coils green with verdigris. The air smells of vinegar
and clean linen. The only way out is south.

24693.name: Chamber Of The Dark Alchemist

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

24693.description:
The black-walled chamber is crowded with crooked shelves of stoppered
bottles, bones and dried roots, and a smoky lamp throws long, crawling
shadows. A table of dark stone is stained in many colours, and a sticky
residue thickens the floor. The air burns the nose. The only way out is
north.

24694.name: Cell Block

north.description: To the north lies The Chief Guard's Office.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Stone Circle.

24694.description:
A stone passage runs between low barred doors, each hiding a bare cell
with a heap of rotten straw. Chains hang from rings in the walls, and
the floor drains toward a central gutter that runs foul. Torchlight
barely reaches the end, where a door leads north to the Chief Guard's
Office. The way south returns to the circle.

24695.name: Cell Block

north.description: To the north lies Around the Stone Circle.

24695.description:
A short passage between barred cell doors, each hiding a bare cell with
a heap of rotten straw. Iron rings in the walls still hold lengths of
rusted chain, and a cracked bucket stinks in a corner. The torchlight is
low and yellow. The only way out is north, back to the circle.

24699.name: Tunnel Inside The Altar

west.description: To the west lies The Grand Stone Of Jostoricath.

east.description: To the east lies The Circle Of The Altars.

24699.description:
The tunnel is hewn through the heart of the altar stones, so low that
you must stoop, and its walls are slick with damp. Handholds and tallow
stubs mark where generations of priests have passed. The passage leads
west toward a pale glow.

647600.name: boar thicket tusker
647600.long_desc: A bristling thicket boar snorts and paws at the leaf litter, its tusks stained dark.
647600.description:
This boar is as big as a pony, its coat a mat of thorns and dried mud.
Its tusks are yellow and curved, and one is notched from fighting in the
briars.

647601.name: spider thorn web weaver
647601.long_desc: A thorn-backed spider hangs motionless in its web, watching with a ring of dull eyes.
647601.description:
A spider as broad as a shield, its long legs bristling with barbs like
the briars it lives among. Its pale belly is mottled with rust red.

647602.name: cultist stone painted
647602.long_desc: A red-painted cultist stands muttering in the shadow of a standing stone, a bone knife in his hand.
647602.description:
A lean, wild-eyed worshipper with his skin smeared in red and white
clay. He wears a kilt of hide and a necklace of knucklebones.

647603.name: guard cell jailer
647603.long_desc: A scarred cell guard keeps watch here, a spiked club slung over one shoulder.
647603.description:
A thick-necked guard in a patched leather jerkin, his knuckles bruised
and his eyes half closed with boredom. A ring of iron keys hangs at his
belt.

647604.name: troll stone hulking
647604.long_desc: A hulking stone troll squats in the gloom, its grey hide indistinguishable from the rock around it.
647604.description:
A troll built like a boulder, its skin cracked and pitted like granite
and furred with moss. Its eyes are small and red, and its fists are the
size of anvils.

647605.name: priest cultist blood bloodied
647605.long_desc: A bloodied cultist priest chants low beside the altar, a curved blade raised in both hands.
647605.description:
A gaunt priest in a robe stiff with old gore, his face daubed with ochre
and his hair matted with grease. His eyes burn with a fierce, glazed
light.

647606.name: thicket beast grummash
647606.long_desc: Grummash, the thicket beast, crouches over a heap of bones, huge and bristling, its hot breath rolling in clouds.
647606.description:
A monstrous thing of fur, thorn and muscle, bigger than a wagon, with
tusks like sabres and a hide matted with briars. Old spear shafts jut
from its back, and its small eyes burn.

647607.name: druid high ulgrathar
647607.long_desc: Ulgrathar, the High Druid, stands at the Slaughter Stone with a sickle gleaming in his hand.
647607.description:
A tall druid in a cloak of black feathers and bark, his white beard
braided with finger bones. Blood runs to his elbows, and the stones hum
with his every word.

747600.name: tusk charm boar bone
747600.room_desc: A carved boar-tusk charm lies here.
747600.description: A curved tusk, scratched with spirals and strung on a leather thong. Cultists wear them to mark a kill.

747601.name: maul stone troll club
747601.room_desc: A chipped stone maul lies here.
747601.description: A slab of granite lashed to a stout oak haft with rawhide. It is heavy and brutal, and the head is pitted with old stains.

747602.name: amulet bloodstone red
747602.description: A dark green stone flecked with red, set in a ring of tarnished copper. It is warm and seems to pulse faintly against the skin.

747603.name: mantle hide cloak thicket
747603.room_desc: A thorny hide mantle lies here.
747603.description: A shaggy cloak cut from the hide of a monstrous beast, still stiff with burrs and briars. It smells of the thicket and keeps out wind and rain.

747604.name: sickle druid curved
747604.room_desc: A moon-bright druid's sickle lies here.
747604.description: A curved blade of pale metal with a handle bound in black feathers. The edge is keen and faintly hums, as the stones of the circle do.
